test_cases_present: partial — the M_CAN User's Manual describes operating modes, register semantics, and protocol behaviors per ISO 11898-1:2015 that directly map to compliance test scenarios but no formal testbench is shipped.
derived_compliance_test_categories: Classical CAN DATA FRAME with each DLC value 0..8 (DLC > 8 interpreted as 8 in Classical mode).
CAN FD DATA FRAME with each DLC value 0..15 (covers all 16 payload sizes 0..64 bytes).
CAN FD DATA FRAME with BRS = 0 (no bit-rate switching) AND BRS = 1 (bit-rate switching) — covering both DBTP and NBTP-only data phases.
CAN FD DATA FRAME with ESI = 1 (error-passive transmitter) AND ESI = 0 (error-active transmitter).
Classical REMOTE FRAME (RTR = recessive) → matching DATA FRAME response (REMOTE FRAMES illegal in CAN FD).
Bitwise arbitration with 2 and 3 nodes starting simultaneously — Classical and CAN-FD frames mixed.
Arbitration loss at first differing bit; loser withdraws and becomes receiver.
Protocol Exception Event (FDF = recessive + res = recessive) → PSR.PXE = 1; behavior under CCCR.PXHD = 0 vs PXHD = 1.
CRC mismatch in Classical CAN (15-bit BCH) → CRC ERROR → ACTIVE ERROR FLAG.
CRC mismatch in CAN FD CRC-17 (≤16-byte payload) → CRC ERROR.
CRC mismatch in CAN FD CRC-21 (>16-byte payload) → CRC ERROR.
Stuff-count parity error in ISO CAN FD (CCCR.NISO = 0) → CRC ERROR.
STUFF ERROR injection (6 consecutive identical bits in stuffed field) — Classical and CAN FD frames.
FORM ERROR injection on Classical CAN fixed-form fields (CRC DELIMITER / ACK DELIMITER / EOF / INTERMISSION).
FORM ERROR injection on CAN FD fixed-form stuff bits.
ACKNOWLEDGMENT ERROR (no dominant ACK after transmitter recessive ACK SLOT).
BIT ERROR in arbitration phase (PSR.LEC ≠ 0,7).
BIT ERROR in data phase of FD frame with BRS = 1 (PSR.DLEC ≠ 0,7) — checked at Secondary Sample Point.
Nominal Bit Timing per-segment programming sweep (NTSEG1 / NTSEG2 / NSJW / NBRP).
Data Bit Timing per-segment programming sweep (DTSEG1 / DTSEG2 / DSJW / DBRP).
Transmitter Delay Compensation: enable DBTP.TDC = 1; verify PSR.TDCV updated on each FD frame; verify SSP position = measured_delay + TDCR.TDCO.
TDC filter window (TDCR.TDCF) suppression of early dominant edges on m_can_rx.
Hard synchronization on SOF — verify CCCR.EFBI = 0 vs CCCR.EFBI = 1 (2-tq dominant filter).
Resynchronization on subsequent edges within ±NSJW (arbitration) and ±DSJW (data).
Fault confinement counter transitions: error-active → error-passive (count ≥128) → bus-off (TX count = 256) → error-active recovery (129 × 11 recessive bits after CCCR.INIT cleared).
Warning level (count ≥ 96) → PSR.EW = 1 + IR.EW.
Error Logging Counter ECR.CEL increment + overflow → IR.ELO.
Restricted Operation Mode (CCCR.ASM = 1) — frame reception with ACK but no own dominant frames; verify TEC + REC frozen, CEL still counting.
Bus Monitoring Mode (CCCR.MON = 1) — receive valid + remote frames; TXBRP held in reset; dominant bits rerouted internally.
Disabled Automatic Retransmission (CCCR.DAR = 1) — corrupted/disturbed frames not retransmitted; verify TXBTO/TXBCF behavior on success / cancel / arbitration-loss / disturbance.
External Loop Back Mode (TEST.LBCK = 1, MON = 0) — Tx visible on m_can_tx + Rx loopback; ACK errors ignored.
Internal Loop Back Mode (TEST.LBCK = 1, MON = 1) — m_can_rx disconnected, m_can_tx recessive; "hot self-test".
Tx Pin Driver Control (TEST.TX = 10 force dominant / 11 force recessive / 01 Sample Point monitor).
Rx Pin Monitor (TEST.RX = m_can_rx pin value).
Power-down: assert m_can_clkstop_req or CCCR.CSR; verify m_can_clkstop_ack + CCCR.CSA after pending Tx + bus idle.
Power-down abort: heavily disturbed bus → idle never reached → software writes CCCR.INIT = 1 to force stop.
Wake-up from power-down: deassert m_can_clkstop_req → reset CCCR.INIT → BSP synchronizes to bus.
Acceptance Filter — range filter (SFT/EFT = 00).
Acceptance Filter — dual-ID filter (SFT/EFT = 01).
Acceptance Filter — classic bit-mask filter (SFT/EFT = 10).
Acceptance Filter — disabled element (SFT/EFT = 11).
Acceptance Filter — store in FIFO0 (SFEC/EFEC = 001).
Acceptance Filter — store in FIFO1 (SFEC/EFEC = 010).
Acceptance Filter — reject (SFEC/EFEC = 011); useful with Sync messages.
Acceptance Filter — set-priority (SFEC/EFEC = 100) → IR.HPM + HPMS update only.
Acceptance Filter — set-priority + store FIFO0 / FIFO1 (SFEC/EFEC = 101 / 110).
Acceptance Filter — store in dedicated Rx Buffer (SFEC/EFEC = 111 + SFID2/EFID2[10:9] = 00).
Acceptance Filter — debug message A / B / C (SFEC/EFEC = 111 + SFID2/EFID2[10:9] = 01 / 10 / 11); verify RXF1S.DMS state machine + m_can_dma_req hand-off.
Acceptance Filter — non-matching frame action via GFC.ANFS / GFC.ANFE.
Acceptance Filter — GFC.RRFS / RRFE reject all remote frames standard / extended.
Acceptance Filter — XIDAM masking for 29-bit IDs (J1939 use case).
Rx FIFO 0 blocking mode (RXF0C.F0OM = 0) — full FIFO drops new messages + IR.RF0L.
Rx FIFO 0 overwrite mode (RXF0C.F0OM = 1) — full FIFO overwrites oldest + put/get both advance.
Rx FIFO 0 watermark (RXF0C.F0WM) → IR.RF0W.
Rx FIFO 1 — same modes + DMS state observability (RXF1S.DMS).
Dedicated Rx Buffer New Data flag handling — NDAT1/NDAT2 set by M_CAN, cleared by Host writing 1; verify IR.DRX.
Tx FIFO transmit-in-put-order (TXBC.TFQM = 0).
Tx Queue transmit-by-lowest-ID (TXBC.TFQM = 1).
Mixed Dedicated Tx Buffers + Tx FIFO / Tx Queue.
Tx Buffer Add Request (TXBAR.AR_n) → TXBRP.TRP_n.
Tx Buffer Cancellation Request (TXBCR.CR_n) → TXBCF.CF_n (dedicated + Queue only, not FIFO).
Tx Event FIFO — verify EFC = 1 in Tx Buffer → write E0/E1 to Tx Event FIFO on transmission complete; verify ET = 01 (Tx event) vs ET = 10 (transmission in spite of cancellation, set in DAR mode).
Tx Event FIFO watermark + full + lost + new-entry interrupts (IR.TEFW / TEFF / TEFL / TEFN).
Internal Timestamp Counter (TSCC.TSS = 01) increment + wraparound → IR.TSW.
External Timestamp Counter via m_can_ext_ts[15:0] (TSCC.TSS = 10) — required for CAN FD.
TSU external 32-bit timestamping (CCCR.UTSU = 1) — verify m_can_tsrx / m_can_tstx pulses + TSC/TXTSP fields.
Wide Message Markers (CCCR.WMM = 1) — verify 16-bit MM in Tx Event FIFO replaces TXTS.
Timeout Counter — continuous mode (CCCR.TOCC.TOS = 00) + Tx Event FIFO mode (01) + Rx FIFO 0 (10) + Rx FIFO 1 (11); verify IR.TOO + counter behavior.
Access to Reserved Address (HOST reads / writes reserved register) → IR.ARA + m_can_aei_ara pulse.
Message RAM Access Failure — provoke RAM no-READY → IR.WDI; provoke Rx Handler / Tx Handler timeout → IR.MRAF (Tx side enters Restricted Operation Mode).
External ECC/Parity feedback — assert m_can_aeim_berr[0] → IR.BEC; assert m_can_aeim_berr[1] → IR.BEU + CCCR.INIT set.
ISO vs non-ISO CAN FD: toggle CCCR.NISO when iso_only_g = 0; verify frame format on bus.
Iso-only synthesis (iso_only_g = 1): verify CCCR.NISO reads 0 + cannot be set to 1.
Transmit Pause (CCCR.TXP = 1) — verify 2-bit-time pause between own successful transmissions.
